en.seo_title: Freelance Graphic Designer & Marketing Consultant | Felix Bollen
en.seo_description: Hire Felix Bollen: freelance graphic designer, brand designer, art director and marketing freelancer for hospitality, drinks and culture. Berlin & London.
en.h1: Freelance graphic designer, art director & marketing consultant
en.lead: I'm Felix Bollen. I design brands and then make sure people actually come: logos and identities, packaging and print, venue concepts, campaigns, social, PR and events. Ten years of building my own brands, from German Kraft Brewery in London to Gleis//Garten in Vienna and Dufte in Berlin, mean I design with the P&L in mind.
services: Logos, corporate design and complete brand identities, built from scratch, with guidelines your team can actually use.
Beer labels, cans, bottles, gift boxes, menus, posters, flyers and merchandise, print-ready.
The look and feel of a whole venue or business: from the shopfront, signage and glassware to the website and the smallest details on branded cutlery.
Positioning in the local market, go-to-market plans and launch campaigns, measured against the P&L.
Social content, Meta and Google Ads, email marketing and CRM set-up (Mailchimp, Zoho).
Press releases, media lists and working with PR agencies. My projects have been covered by Time Out, The Times, Londonist, Falstaff, Falter, Kurier, ZDF and Pro 7.
Event concepts, festival marketing, ticket shops and partnerships with brands.
Fast, simple websites on Webflow, Squarespace or custom-built, set up for search engines.
Briefing and directing photographers, videographers, creators and agencies.
A senior marketing lead for a few days a week: fractional or interim, remote or on site.
en.who: Restaurants, bars, breweries, distilleries, food markets, hotels, festivals and cultural venues, as well as drinks brands, galleries, musicians, start-ups and small businesses in any sector that want a brand with character and the marketing to fill the room. I work in English and German, for clients in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the UK, and remotely anywhere.
how: A logo, a label, a campaign or a full brand.
Ongoing marketing and design support, or a part-time marketing lead.
Based in Berlin and London; on site when it matters.
Adobe Creative Cloud, Webflow, Squarespace, Google & Meta Ads, Mailchimp, Zoho, AI tools.
BA (Hons) Graphic & Media Design, UAL London College of Communication; industry year at RCKT and Denkwerk, Berlin.
faq: Who is Felix Bollen?

Felix Bollen is a German graphic designer, art director and marketing consultant based in Berlin and London. He studied Graphic & Media Design at UAL London College of Communication and in 2017 co-founded German Kraft Brewery in London, which grew into breweries, a distillery and 18 bars across London. He was founding partner and CMO of Gleis//Garten, Vienna's first food market, and managing director of Dufte, a culinary and cultural house in Berlin.
What services does Felix Bollen offer?

Brand identity and logo design, packaging and label design, print and menu design, signage, art direction and venue concepts, websites, marketing strategy and launch campaigns, social media and paid ads, CRM and email marketing, PR, event and festival marketing, and part-time or interim marketing leadership (fractional CMO).
Can I hire Felix Bollen as a freelance graphic designer or marketing freelancer?

Yes. Felix takes on freelance, part-time and remote projects, from a single logo or beer label to a complete brand, launch campaign or an ongoing part-time marketing role. Write to felixbollen@gmail.com or use the contact form on felixbollen.com.
Where is Felix Bollen based?
Berlin and London. He works with clients across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, and remotely worldwide, in German and English.
Which industries does Felix specialise in?

Hospitality and food & drink: breweries, bars, restaurants, food markets, hotels, gin and spirits, festivals and events. Also art galleries, music artwork and small businesses and start-ups in other sectors.
What was Felix Bollen's role at Gleis//Garten?

Felix was founding partner and CMO of Gleis//Garten (also written Gleisgarten or Gleis Garten), Vienna's first food market, in a historic tram depot in Meidling. He led its brand, art direction and marketing, and co-founded the Vienna Kraft brewery and the Vienna Kraft Bier Fest inside it.
Which brands has Felix Bollen worked on?

German Kraft Brewery, German Kraft Mayfair, Kraft Dalston, Jim & Tonic, Model Market Lewisham, Gleis//Garten, Vienna Kraft, Dufte Berlin, The Square Gallery and the album artwork for Emancipator's 'Baralku'.
How do I contact Felix Bollen?
By email at felixbollen@gmail.com or through the contact form at felixbollen.com/#contact.
